Lina Ortega: Hi folks :wave: I'm Lina — starting today on Data Platform as a Data Engineer. Quick setup q: my MDM enrollment email hasn't arrived yet. Should I file an IT ticket or ping someone here? Also hi! Fun fact: I'm trying to perfect sourdough and bouldering on weekends. :)

Kelsey Park: Welcome Lina :tada: — Kelsey here (People Ops). I just DM'd you the onboarding checklist. For MDM, ping @Ezra (infra) or reply here and we'll prioritize.

Aisha Malik: Hey Lina! Welcome :) I'm on the platform team — happy to help with repo access and local env. DM me your work email and I’ll start permissions.

Ezra Nguyen: Tagging infra — got it. Lina, check the self-serve at https://intranet.redwood.com/self-serve/onboarding. If that doesn't work, reply with your laptop serial (or email) and I’ll escalate. Example check command for macs (safe):
```
# check MDM status
profiles status
```
(ops note: no sudo needed for that check)

Connor Lee: I’ll add you to the data-platform GitHub team in a few mins, Lina. Also added you to #data-platform Slack.

Lina Ortega: Amazing, thanks everyone! One more: who coordinates badge access and desk assignment?

Kelsey Park: I’ll loop Facilities. Expect an email from facilities@redwood within 24 hrs with desk and badge details.

Aisha Malik: Also FYI we've scheduled the onboarding 1:1 and team sync on your calendar. If you want a buddy for first-week pairing ping me.

welcome-bot: Lina, welcome to Redwood Inference! Check out #new-hires for onboarding resources and the "Getting started" doc.

Lina Ortega: Love it — thanks all. Who's up for lunch later this week? :salad: 

Connor Lee: Team lunch is usually Friday at noon — I’ll drop a doodle: https://doodle.com/schedule/xyz

Lina Ortega: Perfect — see you all soon! :sparkles:
